# What does one esthetician's chair really earn, and should you work it, employ or rent it out?

> Free esthetician studio calculator: enter facial, waxing and peel prices, chair minutes, supplies, no-show rate, rent and commission, and see profit per treatment and per chair hour, the price for your target margin, break-even treatments per week and whether to rent the chair or employ an esthetician.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
